takes.situation: Money first: Milena compares late stamps on Bureau cards, and the debt leads to the door.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: Bureau stamped my card late again. How many's on yours?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Oh, Milena, again? Keep your voice down. Did someone ask about me?

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: You always think that. Nobody asks about waitresses. How far behind?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Five stamps. I wait tables, Milena. I can't keep up.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: Five. So what's at the Office door worth all that looking?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Who said anything about the door? Who else has noticed?

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: Nobody else. I only guessed. You and Okafor, on that door?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Yes. I'm seeing him. If the Office hears, it costs us both.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: His post, your name, five stamps. You can't afford any of it.

beats.speaker: Scout
beats.line: Owes the Bureau, behind. Loan could be cleared. Okafor could be used.

takes.situation: Door first: Milena has counted the looks, and Inez hides behind the debt until it fails.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: Six looks at the Office door this shift. I count things.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Six? Who else is counting? I've got the whole terrace to clear.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: You always jump. Nobody watches a door for nothing. What's it paying?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: It's the Bureau, that's all. I'm behind and I can't keep up.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: Their collector's clockwork. It doesn't stand the Office door. Okafor does.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Okafor? Did he say something? Who else has he said it to?

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: He said nothing. You just did. So you're seeing the door guard.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: I am. If the Office hears, it costs us both. Please, Milena.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: You wait tables and owe the Bureau. Can you afford that secret?

beats.speaker: Scout
beats.line: Bureau loan, behind. Could be cleared. Okafor, Office door. Could be used.

takes.situation: Inez starts it: her anxious question about a Bureau notice gives her away, with the Scout placing the scene first.

beats.speaker: Scout
beats.line: Palms, two metres. Two café waitresses, one inside. Neither's seen me.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Milena, your Bureau notice. Does it say who else they've written to?

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: It says what I owe. Why, what's yours say?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: More than yours. I can't keep up. Is anyone in there?

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: Nobody, same as always. They write only to you. Why?

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Does it go through the Office? Would they see my name there?

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: What's your name to the Office? You've watched that door all shift.

beats.speaker: Inez
beats.line: Okafor. I'm seeing him. If the Office hears, it costs us both.

beats.speaker: Milena
beats.line: His post gone and your loan still due. See to your tables.

beats.speaker: Scout
beats.line: Loan, behind. Could clear it. Okafor, Office door. Could use that.
